latestVersion.changelog:
Neural Frames AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate 1080p AI videos from written prompts, no video editing skills required.
- Connects automatically to backend; supports both registered and anonymous users.
- Quick workflow: upload prompt, generate video (typically 1–3 minutes), and download result.
- Handles uploads, exports, credits/balance checks, and timeline state queries.
- Built-in error handling for token/session issues, file limits, and matchmaking of user requests to actions.
- No timeline dragging or complex export settings — just describe your desired content in text.
